name: 1.22.0-beta.24
notes: Find variants by hand: a see-through layer now gives back its own version as it was. Where the effect is not just one colour laid over (more than one colour, or more than a tint), it takes whatever colour and strength give what the version shows, instead of forcing one colour.

For a tint whose colour changes (a coloured gradient), a see-through layer can use “Same strength”: one strength everywhere (with a slider), and the colour is found at each point. Look at “Rebuilt” on another version that has it to set the strength.
